calendar_entries_time_check.name: calendar_entries_time_check
calendar_entries_time_check.value: ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at >= starts_at

outreach_prospect_evidence_external_sour.name: outreach_prospect_evidence_external_source_key
outreach_prospect_evidence_external_sour.where: (source_key IS NOT NULL AND meeting_id IS NULL)

payment_transaction_list_amount_minor_ch.name: payment_transaction_list_amount_minor_check
payment_transaction_list_amount_minor_ch.value: list_amount_minor IS NULL OR list_amount_minor >= amount_minor

payment_transaction_session_check.name: payment_transaction_session_check
payment_transaction_session_check.value: ((checkout_session_id IS NOT NULL) AND (top_up_session_id IS NULL)) OR ((checkout_session_id IS NULL) AND (top_up_session_id IS NOT NULL))

product_events_external_delivery_key.name: product_events_external_delivery_key
product_events_external_delivery_key.where: (origin = 'external_connector' AND connector_id IS NOT NULL AND external_event_id IS NOT NULL)

promotion_version_discount_type_check.name: promotion_version_discount_type_check
promotion_version_discount_type_check.value: discount_type IS NULL OR discount_type = ANY (ARRAY['percentage'::text, 'fixed'::text])

promotion_version_duration_check.name: promotion_version_duration_check
promotion_version_duration_check.value: duration IS NULL OR duration = ANY (ARRAY['once'::text, 'repeating'::text, 'forever'::text])

promotion_version_trial_days_check.name: promotion_version_trial_days_check
promotion_version_trial_days_check.value: trial_days IS NULL OR (trial_days > 0 AND trial_days <= 90)

promotion_version_percent_check.name: promotion_version_percent_check
promotion_version_percent_check.value: percent_off_basis_points IS NULL OR (percent_off_basis_points > 0 AND percent_off_basis_points <= 10000)

top_up_payment_reconcile_idx.name: top_up_payment_reconcile_idx
top_up_payment_reconcile_idx.where: ((fulfilled_at IS NULL) AND (provider_order_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['checkout_ready'::text, 'processing'::text, 'expired'::text])))
